<!-- work-order:scenarios/ui-visual.md:U130-U131-L41 -->
## Outcome
visual pass 1, Tokens: `tokens.css` holds every look value (starting values in `docs/design-system.md`), the four stylesheets read `var(--…)`, type and space steps; `loop/rules.sh tokens` with its tests, run by a `tokens` step in `.github/workflows/loop.yml`

## Acceptance
Scenarios: U130, U131, L41
Specification: [scenarios/ui-visual.md](https://github.com/saadshahd/roundup/blob/main/scenarios/ui-visual.md)

## Scope
`apps/desktop/src/tokens.css`, `apps/desktop/src/**/*.css`, `apps/desktop/src/main.tsx`, `apps/desktop/src/testing/harness.tsx`, `apps/desktop/src/testing/contrast.ts`, the inline styles of `apps/desktop/src/**/*.tsx`, `apps/desktop/src/ink/u4_contrast_tokens.test.ts`, slice 3 only `apps/desktop/src/ink/glyph.ts`, `apps/desktop/src/ink/glyph.test.ts` and `apps/desktop/src/ink/KindGlyph.test.tsx` (`working` and `idle` share the tone `light`; U132 then only tests the Kind tones), `loop/rules.sh`, `loop/rules.test.sh`, `.github/workflows/loop.yml` (the scenario says so)

## Preserve
every existing `apps/desktop` test; each `u4_`, `u5_` or `u20_` test that asserts a colour U130 replaces is changed and named in the PR

## Dependencies
now, unless the `contrast` row is already in flight, then after it (D5 carries its ratios); three slices of U130 as `scenarios/ui-visual.md` orders them (Tokens with light values, one PR per stylesheet, then the dark block); L41's `tokens` step lands with the PR that leaves no literal outside `tokens.css`, so the check and the last migration land together; the `pads/` inline-style PR merges after U50, slice 3 after U50; the L41 PR opens only when no `loop-rules-*` PR is open (one writer of `loop/rules.sh` at a time), and adds only the `tokens` step if `loop-rules-4` already built `tokens`

## Delivery
No implementation PR linked yet.

## Queue
Key: U130-U131-L41
Priority: 100
Migration state: unspecified

Imported from the Work table. The issue-backed queue is being installed; this issue does not create a second Builder. Completion requires delivery evidence, not a matching test name.

goals.statement: `apps/desktop/src/tokens.css` defines every Token in the `docs/design-system.md` table with its light value and, where the table differs, its dark value. No stylesheet or component inline style under `apps/desktop/src` other than `tokens.css` holds a colour, font-size, radius, box-shadow or duration literal: each such property reads `var(--…)`. On a rendered Rail, Shelf, Drawer and pane, every computed colour, background, border colour, shadow, radius and duration is a Token's value (U130, D1).
goals.observer: The `u130_` vitest tests in `apps/desktop`, including a whole-tree `u130_no_look_literal_outside_tokens_css` and a D1 assertion through `testing/checks.ts` on the rendered Rail, Shelf, Drawer and pane

goals.statement: Type and space steps hold on the rendered screens: every computed font size is 11, 12, 13 or 15 px. Every font family is `--font-ui`, except the Terminal, a path, an id and code, which use `--font-mono`. Every margin, padding and gap is 0 or 4, 8, 12, 16, 24 or 32 px. A Rail row and the `✓ <n> done` fold line are 28 px high at rest, hovered and selected (U131, D2).
goals.observer: The `u131_` vitest tests in `apps/desktop`, covering row height and the computed type, family and space steps through D2 of `testing/checks.ts`

goals.statement: `loop/rules.sh tokens` scans `apps/desktop/src` and prints `file:line` for each look literal outside `tokens.css`, then exits 1. It exits 0 on a clean tree and fails loudly when `tokens.css` is missing. Its cases are tested in `loop/rules.test.sh` (L41).
goals.observer: `bash loop/rules.test.sh` (the `l41_` cases) and `bash loop/rules.sh tokens` on a checkout of main, which exits 0

goals.statement: `.github/workflows/loop.yml` runs a `tokens` step that calls `loop/rules.sh tokens`, and that step passes on main (L41 in CI).
goals.observer: `grep -n tokens .github/workflows/loop.yml` on main, plus the `loop.yml` run for a main push showing the `tokens` step green

deliveries.title: L41 specification: restore the `tokens` literal scan to scenarios/loop-rules.md
deliveries.body:
## Outcome
The L41 scenario is back on main in `scenarios/loop-rules.md`, so the `loop/rules.sh tokens` implementation that #386 owns has an acceptance specification. Commit 7ac14b1 ("Split loop.md by tool and cut each built scenario to its rule") cut L41's text into a Work row, and the scenario files no longer contain it. #386 and #364 both name `scenarios/loop-rules.md:L41`, but no L41 heading exists there.

Proposed scenario text, added in id order after L37 (it matches U130's categories and the exit table at the top of `loop-rules.md`):

**L41 tokens.** `tokens` scans every `.css`, `.ts` and `.tsx` file under `apps/desktop/src` except `tokens.css`, files ending in `.test.ts` or `.test.tsx` (a test states expected values) and `terminal/emulator.ts` (xterm's options, outside U130's scan). It prints `file:line: <property>: <value>` for each colour literal (`#rgb` to `#rrggbbaa`, `rgb(`, `rgba(`, `hsl(`, `hsla(`, a named colour) and each `font-size`, `border-radius`, `box-shadow`, `transition`/`animation` duration value, whether in a stylesheet declaration or in an inline `style` object of a `.tsx` file, and exits 1 when it prints any. A value of `0`, `inherit`, `transparent`, `currentColor`, `none` or one made only of `var(--…)` reads passes, and so does anything inside a comment. A custom property definition outside `tokens.css` that holds a colour or a time is a literal. A missing `apps/desktop/src/tokens.css` exits 2, naming it. It exits 0 when nothing is found. This repeats U130's literal scan in CI without a browser; `.github/workflows/loop.yml` runs it as the `tokens` step. Cases (`l41_` in `loop/rules.test.sh`, each in a throwaway repo): one offence of each kind, among them an inline `style={{ color: "#fff" }}`, an inline `style={{ "font-size": "12px" }}` and a `.css` `transition: opacity 120ms`, each printed with its `file:line` and exit 1; a clean tree holding a `u1.test.ts` with `"#fff"`, an inline `style={{ "white-space": "pre" }}`, a `style={{ color: "var(--grey)" }}` and a commented-out `/* color: #fff */`, exit 0; no `tokens.css`, exit 2.

## Scope
`scenarios/loop-rules.md` (the L41 paragraph only). Mode: specify. Do not change any scenario other than L41, and do not touch code.

## Acceptance
Scenarios: L41
Specification: [scenarios/loop-rules.md](https://github.com/saadshahd/roundup/blob/main/scenarios/loop-rules.md)
Observer: `grep -n '^\*\*L41 tokens\.\*\*' scenarios/loop-rules.md` on main prints exactly one line, and that paragraph names the scanned tree, the exclusions, the `file:line` output, exits 0/1/2 and the `l41_` cases above.

## Preserve
Every other scenario in `scenarios/loop-rules.md` byte for byte. U130's text in `scenarios/ui-visual.md` stays unchanged. L41 stays the scan U130 names ("`loop/rules.sh tokens` (L41) repeats the literal scan in CI").

## Dependencies
none. #386 (U130-U131-L41) builds L41 after this specification merges. #364 holds a duplicate L41 Key, which is an engineering repair for the controller: one owner for L41.

Key: L41-spec
Priority: 50
Mode: specify
Provider: any
